issues.message: Header "### Scenario: wrong level" in ADDED Requirements is not a "### Requirement:" header and is ignored by validation. Use "### Requirement: Scenario: wrong level" if it should be validated as a requirement.
ADDED "No scenario here" should contain SHALL or MUST (RFC 2119 best practice for English specs)
ADDED "No scenario here" must include at least one scenario
ADDED "Three hashes" must include at least one scenario
